description: List the tags pushed for one image in this organization's Edgegap container registry, with push time and size. Call it after docker push to confirm the tag landed before edgegap_create_app_version, which otherwise fails later with an image-pull error. An image that was never pushed comes back as status "not_found" with no tags, not as an error. Only for registry.edgegap.com: images in Docker Hub, GHCR or another registry are not listed here.

image_name.description: The image name only, without the project, registry host or tag, e.g. "my-game-server". The API reads the project from your token; "<project>/my-game-server" is not found.

name: edgegap_list_registry_tags
title: List image tags in the Edgegap registry
